name: libcso
description: Shared libc SP2: a program statically linked against libc's library-mode compile, whose startup (crt0_lib.s: libc's _libc_start, then _lib_init) gave it its own libc blocks.  Its argv and __progname, _lib_init's bitmap (one row of a table of its own) and an empty table; core state, a zeroed and an initialised block static, a literal, strtok and asctime across calls with results in the process's own block, sbrk stopping at the lowered HEAP_LIM, fork (child's blocks its own) and vfork (child borrows the parent's), a signal handler calling libc, libc's code across several banks.
